product_lineage.devicex: SDX installed on specific hardware — branded appliance (Branch-in-a-Box, School-in-a-Box)
product_lineage.stackx: Management, orchestration, observability, automation, ITSM, compliance, and SOC platform layer above/around DeviceX/SDX

devicex_sdx.description: Capability modules for the site edge. SD-WAN is the core; the others are optional add-ons.

modules.name: SD-WAN
modules.summary: Resilient, quality-steered wide-area connectivity over any mix of access services.
modules.notes: Core module — include in every DeviceX proposal unless SD-WAN is not required.

modules.name: Firewall
modules.summary: Stateful or next-generation firewall with in-site micro-segmentation.
modules.notes: Base stateful firewall or the enhanced next-generation variant — choose per bid.

modules.name: SASE / Zero Trust Access
modules.summary: Identity- and device-aware access control at the site edge.

modules.name: Network Services (DNS, DHCP, LDAP, RADIUS)
modules.summary: Core network services delivered on the appliance at each site.

modules.name: NVR / Video Surveillance
modules.summary: Local video recording with central monitoring and optional edge analytics.
modules.notes: Two variants: without analytics, or with edge analytics — choose per bid.

modules.name: IP-PBX / Unified Communications
modules.summary: Site telephony with call routing, IVR, recording and local survivability.

modules.name: Virtualization / Container Platform
modules.summary: Virtual machines and containers hosted at the site edge.

modules.name: Business Workloads Hosting Platform
modules.summary: Managed hosting for business-critical applications.

modules.name: DeviceX/SDX Centralized Operations
modules.summary: Central provisioning, policy and monitoring of every appliance, with zero-touch provisioning and attestation.

stackx.group: StackX — Control / Orchestration / SOC / Operations Layer
stackx.description: Capability modules for IT operations, service management and security.

modules.name: StackX TrueView
modules.summary: Business and technical service dashboards that correlate data across systems.

modules.name: StackX Observability & APM
modules.summary: Metrics, logs and traces with anomaly detection and application performance monitoring.

modules.name: StackX Operations Monitoring & Configuration Management
modules.summary: Automated discovery, CMDB and consolidated event management across the IT estate.

modules.name: StackX Network Operations
modules.summary: Network fault, availability and performance management with root-cause analysis.

modules.name: StackX Event & Log Management
modules.summary: Central collection, retention, search and analysis of logs and events.

modules.name: StackX ITSM
modules.summary: ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change and request management with a service portal.

modules.name: StackX Automation & Orchestration
modules.summary: No-code automation of multi-vendor devices and end-to-end workflows.

modules.name: StackX Endpoint Management & Analytics
modules.summary: Inventory, software distribution, remote management and user analytics for endpoints.

modules.name: StackX Identity Management (IDM)
modules.summary: Identity lifecycle, role-based access control and directory integration.

modules.name: StackX Backup
modules.summary: Scheduled, incremental backup with fast recovery and immutable copies.

modules.name: StackX Security
modules.summary: SIEM, SOAR, endpoint, network and threat intelligence capabilities for detection and response.

modules.name: StackX Compliance Assurance
modules.summary: Continuous configuration and vulnerability assessment with audit-ready compliance evidence.

modules.name: StackX Operations Integrity
modules.summary: Configuration baselines, drift detection and controlled, verified access to IT operations.

modules.name: StackX SOC Operations
modules.summary: Security monitoring and incident response operated by Verto Wave on the StackX platform.
modules.notes: A managed service: included only when managed services are part of the offering.

modules.name: StackX DevOps Framework
modules.summary: A governed release pipeline from development to production with digital change records.

modules.name: StackX Application Lifecycle Management (ALM)
modules.summary: Performance and functional test automation for applications before release.

modules.name: StackX Call Center Management
modules.summary: Omnichannel contact center with skills-based routing, IVR and quality management.

modules.name: Network Operations Management

modules.name: Runbook Automation and Orchestration
